Package com.javiergs.rtde4j.model

Class CartesianData

java.lang.Object
com.javiergs.rtde4j.model.CartesianData
public class CartesianData extends Object
Mutable TCP pose and TCP offset container. Positions are expressed in meters and orientation components are axis-angle rotation-vector coordinates in radians.
Version:
1.0.0 (2026.10.26)
